profile.summary: Mid-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Lodash's internal architecture and a strong focus on documentation quality and minor code refactoring. Specializes in improving readability, fixing documentation inconsistencies, and optimizing internal utility functions. Contributions demonstrate functional programming knowledge through Lodash's chaining and binding patterns, along with attention to code style and tooling (EditorConfig, CI/CD awareness). No evidence of frontend/backend framework experience or testing practices.
